newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends 0.10 lower vs dlr at 1,080.40.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends 0.10 lower vs dlr at 1,080.40.

text.p: Colombia's peso edged down 0.10 centavos against the dollar to close at 1,080.40 in lackluster trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
"The market was very stable," one trader said. "It's known that there are dollars out there but the (exchange) rate doesn't want to budge," he added.
Dealers reported 280 trades for a total of $131 million and said the peso hit an intraday low of 1,081.50 before cutting it losses ahead of the close.
